correctness.rationale: Both independent membership predicates agree on all 16384 subsets. Exactly 2256 faces, 1121 matching pairs, one critical 0-cell and thirteen critical 5-cells; directed Hasse graph of 10150 coverings topologically sorts all 2256 faces. Thus Forman yields the integral 13-fold sphere wedge. The complete 336-element automorphism set is constructed and each character value verified by both signed fixed-face and cycle-union Lefschetz computations. Character equality with epsilon plus induction of the seven-point augmentation representation determines the rational module; exact mod-two ranks corroborate. The standalone verifier was run from the actual scientific package.

value.rationale: The Fano incidence graph is a canonical highly symmetric (3,6)-cage, and Ind_2 is the first natural enlargement of ordinary independence. The unexpected integral fifth-dimensional 13-sphere wedge and a complete rational 336-group representation identify real topological and symmetry structure absent from existing ordinary independence and edge matching calculations. The rational symmetry quotient acyclicity is a natural consequence. No assertion of a universal projective-plane theorem is made.
